citations.C1: Missing or misnamed columns (`"Price "`, `"PRICE"`, BOM-prefixed `"\ufeffprice"`) raise KeyError
citations.C3: Empty, whitespace-only, `None`, `"N/A"`, `"NULL"` cells raise ValueError/TypeError; define null handling (skip, zero, or fail) explicitly
citations.C4: Currency formatting: `"$1,234.56"`, `"(12.00)"`, `"1 234"`, trailing `"USD"` all raise ValueError; strip/normalize with a strict regex
citations.C5: Quantity as `"3.0"`, `"1e3"`, `"3,000"` raises in `int()`; parse via Decimal and require it to be integral.
citations.C6: Binary float drift: `float("0.10")` isn't 0.10 and cents accumulate error over many rows; parse with `Decimal(str)` directly from the string
citations.C7: Negative price or qty silently shrinks revenue and can hide corruption; enforce a sign policy
citations.C8: Silent NaN/inf: `float("nan")`, `"inf"`, `"-Infinity"` (any case) parse fine and poison the total; reject non-finite values
citations.C9: One bad row aborts the whole run with no row index or value in the traceback; wrap per-row errors with row number and raw cell content.
